scope: Complete contextual language review of the 50 navigation candidates remaining after PR437; not a whole-catalogue review.

summary.review_level: Independent AI/contextual review, mainly medium confidence, with targeted published usage support.

orthography: Preserve the existing English-spelled technical vocabulary embedded in Nigerian Pidgin grammar. The existence of alternative orthographies does not require respelling this catalogue. Equality with English does not independently prove either quality or a defect.

sources.use: Research on orthographic variation and absence of an adopted universal orthographic standard. Supports avoiding mechanical respelling, not individual technical-term approval.
sources.read_status: Opened publisher abstract; full PDF not inspected.

sources.use: Specialist survey of Nigerian Pidgin; English lexifier, variation and language structure. Supports language-level context, not every caption.
Banat interview dated 2018-12-07 contains airbrush in genuine Cebuano artist speech. Supports the technical borrowing, not digital-UI testing.
sources.read_status: Opened and read relevant full article passage.

sources.use: Published Tok Pisin uses droim piksa for drawing pictures and muvim for moving an object. Supports those lexical elements; zoom/view computer phrase remains an AI/context/catalogue consistency judgment.
sources.read_status: Opened; relevant usages at article paragraphs near lines 139 and 143.

limits: Retention is a bounded AI/contextual judgment, usually medium confidence, not dictionary attestation of all technical terms.

dependent_caption_references.before: Drawing canvas. Pinch and move two fingers to zoom and pan. Navigate mode fit also pan with one finger.
dependent_caption_references.after: Canvas for drawing. Pinch and move two fingers to zoom and move di view. For Move / zoom di view mode, you fit also move di view with one finger without drawing.
meaning_checks: drawing canvas remains a drawing surface
pinch and movement use two fingers for zoom/pan
one finger is stated only for moving the view in the named mode
no one-finger zoom or movement of image pixels is implied
named caption text matches Move / zoom di view
explicitly states no drawing for that one-finger pan
dependent_caption_references.evidence_level: Independent AI full-value review against actual ZOOM mode and the existing catalogue; no new direct human or device test.

dependent_caption_references.before: Kenvas bilong drawing. Pinsim na muvim tupela pinga long zum na pan. Navigate mod i save pan long wanpela pinga tu.
dependent_caption_references.after: Kenvas bilong droim piksa. Pinsim na muvim tupela pinga long zum na muvim viw. Long mod bilong zum na muvim viw, yu inap muvim viw long wanpela pinga tu.
meaning_checks: two-finger pinch and movement control zoom and pan
final clause allows one-finger view movement only
does not say that one finger zooms or moves image pixels
descriptive mode reference matches Zum na muvim viw
dependent_caption_references.evidence_level: Independent AI full-value review and catalogue consistency; external published usage supports droim/muvim only, not the complete UI sentence.
